name: Olive Chicken with Roasted Onions, Bell Peppers & Artichokes over Rice
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and medium dice onions. Peel and thinly slice garlic. Transfer both to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the bowl with the onions and garlic.
Drain artichokes and add to the bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl. Add oil and spices, then toss to combine.
Transfer veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Mince olives and place in the reserved bowl; add oil and stir to combine the olive mixture.
Season both sides of the chicken with salt and pepper; nestle chicken in the veggies on the baking sheet. Spoon olive mixture over the chicken.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender, about 20 minutes.
To serve, divide rice, roasted veggies, and chicken between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
